integrity: The claim is supported by a self-contained finite-graph proof, a finite exhaustive corroboration, and statement-level comparison with inspected primary and supporting literature. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to real scalars and finite connected simple graphs with the unit-edge shortest-path metric.
It classifies exactly the threshold \(n(\mathcal F(V))=1\) but does not compute the numerical index for nonbipartite graphs.
The finite exhaustive checker is corroborative; the all-orders conclusion rests on the symbolic proof.
An equivalent older result under Arens--Eells, transportation-cost, CL-space, or polyhedral terminology remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Bipartiteness exactly characterizes numerical index one for finite graph metrics
